description: MATGRID, published by mcosovic, implements AC and DC power flow, state estimation, PMU placement, measurement generation and bad-data processing as a MATLAB package. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Some README functions are labelled beta; current runtime compatibility was not tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The provider describes MATGRID as inspired by model-matpower, not the same package.
name: MATGRID
notes: Reusable documented research and education package with several distinct analytical functions. Original discovery: A1/A1-0017. Geography and simulation-use tags are screening classifications.
